candidate_claim_transitions.statement_of_discharge: codes/loop/loop.sbatch now writes .failcount in exactly one place, finalize(), which runs from trap 'finalize $?' EXIT installed immediately after resubmit(). Every termination path between the resubmit and the end of the script therefore updates the count, applies the minimum-runtime penalty and cancels the queued successor: a missing or unreadable env.sh, an env.sh that exports no KATAGO_SRC, a missing synchronous_loop_9x9.sh, a failed cd, a non-zero scratch_guard, and any unhandled set -u abort. A pre-flight failure (the loop never started) always cancels the successor, because the successor would repeat it deterministically. A link that starts with .failcount >= KTG_MAX_FAILS or .breaker_tripped present exits before the loop, so the post-trip successor of validation.md F2 can no longer spend a fourth attempt, and an exit 0 that never ran the loop no longer resets the count. Existing depth cap and breaker arithmetic unchanged: a crash loop still trips on link 2 (failcount 2 then 4 with the fast-failure penalty).
